newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia concerned over U.S. Jerusalem vote.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia concerned over U.S. Jerusalem vote.

text.p: Indonesia, the world's largest Moslem nation, said on Friday it viewed with "deep concern" a U.S. congressional resolution calling for recognition of Jerusalem as the undivided capital of Israel.
The U.S. House of Representatives approved a non-binding resolution by 406 votes to 17 on June 10 calling on President Bill Clinton to reaffirm that Jerusalem must remain Israel's undivided capital.
"Indonesia expresses its deep concern on the resolution...," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement.

"Indonesia is of the view that the resolution is a dangerous move which could jeopardise the Middle East peace process, particularly the international efforts to achieve peace between Palestine and Israel," it said.
It added that it supported the Palestinian people in their struggle to establish an independent and sovereign state with Jerusalem as its capital.
Israel captured Arab East Jerusalem in 1967 and annexed it in a move unrecognised by the international community, including the United States.
